{07 00 00}This might seem a bit

I've got a question...
Have you heard of the
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}?{01 00 00 05 00}

messages.en:
{07 00 00}This is the perfect season
for catching a TON of
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}.
If you can't catch one,
why, {07 14 00}you can hardly call
yourself a real fisher!
{07 00 00}Let's test your dedication,
{04 1f 00}! Let's see who
can catch one first!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}See on ideaalne hooaeg, et
püüda TONNIDE viisi
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}.
Kui sa ei suuda ühte püüda,
siis {07 14 00}vaevalt saad sa end
nimetada päris kalameheks!
{07 00 00}Paneme su pühendumuse
proovile, {04 1f 00}! Vaatame,

messages.en:
{07 00 00}People are always saying
fish is supposed to be a
brain food, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}Does that go for all fish?{01 00 00 05 00}
Like, would it work if I ate
{07 0b 00}{04 1a 00}?
{07 00 00}I feel like I ought to stock
up on them. You know, {07 11 00}for
when I'm having a down day.
{07 0c 00}I've got an idea!{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 00 00} If you
and I both try to catch
them, I'll double my stock!
{07 14 00}Let's make a contest out
of it, {04 1f 00}. {01 00 00 05 00}I'll bet
I can catch one before you!
messages.et:
